maddeler.e:
أنقبض (form VII)
# أَنْقَبِضُ (ʔanqabiḍu) /ʔan.qa.bi.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
# أَنْقَبِضَ (ʔanqabiḍa) /ʔan.qa.bi.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
# أَنْقَبِضْ (ʔanqabiḍ) /ʔan.qa.bidˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
